feed.title: Exclusive LLM — What's new in our games
feed.subtitle: Major updates to our games on Google Play, newest first.

entry.title: Exclusive Quiz 2.8.4: Exclusive Quiz is on Google Play
entry.content:
• General knowledge questions in English and Turkish across 10 categories, with a short explanation for every right answer
  • Daily challenge, Sudden death and Time attack modes
  • My mistakes: the questions you missed wait for you
  • Leaderboards and achievements with Google Play Games

entry.title: BlockFour 2.4.3: Google Play Games: achievements and leaderboards
entry.content:
• 12 achievements to unlock across all four games
  • A separate leaderboard for each of the four games
  • Open them in one tap from the Records screen

entry.title: BlockNest 1.2.0: Google Play Games: 18 achievements and a leaderboard
entry.content:
• 18 achievement badges to unlock
  • A best-score leaderboard for Classic mode
  • Open them in one tap from the Records screen

entry.title: Woodora Classic 1.0.16: Google Play Games: achievements and a leaderboard
entry.content:
• 10 achievements to unlock
  • A best-score leaderboard to compare your record
  • Open them in one tap from the game menu

entry.title: BlockFour 2.4.0: A new premium look
entry.content:
• Gem-like glossy blocks, sparkles and particle effects in all four games and the menu
  • A burst animation when you clear lines in Falling Blocks
  • A short moment to slide the piece after a fast drop, before it locks

entry.title: Woodora Classic 1.0.15: Woodora Classic is on Google Play
entry.content:
• Classic wooden design and an 8×8 board
  • A preview that shows how many lines a placement will clear
  • Multi-line and streak bonuses, plus auto-save
  • English, Turkish, Spanish and Arabic
